a: 5 years of academic-year salary and fringe (100% for years 1-2, 50% for years 3-5) plus $50,000/yr research allowance; up to 6 awards
dt: Letter of intent due Jan 21, 2027, 12 pm ET (no institutional sign-off needed); LOI decisions by May 31, 2027; non-competitive full proposal once hired, no later than Jun 1, 2028
e: For scientific-software researchers with a PhD in mathematics, astronomy or theoretical physics (or a related field at comparable mathematical level) who have led development of research software. Selected awardees must be hired into a new, non-term-limited research or teaching-track faculty position (e.g. research professor, professor of practice) in a math, astronomy or physics department at a US PhD-granting institution, starting by Sep 1, 2028. No citizenship requirement.
n: Simons Foundation: Scientific Software Research Faculty (SSRF) Award (2027–2028)
